notes: The evidence shows the box is stochastic: identical inputs (E10, E12) return different values, and nearby inputs show no continuity or trend, so the only defensible mechanism is a random draw from a fixed, x-independent distribution (mean 0, std ≈ 0.1, range ≈ ±0.32). My model reproduces that by returning an independent random sample of that distribution for each element of the probe.
